_comment: One entry per domain. The pipeline is the same for all of them; a domain picks the prompts, the data and the models.
null = use the global setting (SANITISE_MODEL, SANITISE_ANSWER_BACKEND, ...).
model: Agents 2-3 through Ollama (and Agent 1's LLM pass unless agent1_backend is 'transformers').
answer_backend: same | gemini | ollama | mock. gemini_model: gemini-3.5-flash or gemini-3.8-flash.
agent1_backend: same | transformers (Gemma 4 + the LoRA adapter at agent1_adapter, on a GPU).
prompts: which prompt family the agents use (medical or legal). A new domain uses one of them until its own prompts are written.
To add a domain, copy the legal entry, give it a new name and point its paths at that domain's data.
